transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for gathering. I wanted to get us all on the same page regarding the comedy benefit's guest segment this Saturday evening. We've got a fifteen-minute slot at 7:40 PM that needs to end before the 8:00 PM news break, and Lio Hart and Mara Vale are our two finalists. Before I make the binding booking call, I need artist relations, broadcast engineering, clearance, and sponsor integration to review the proposed guest package with me. I don't have any private information beyond what we all share, so let's start pooling what we each know to make the best decision. What can each of you tell me?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share an important update I confirmed with both agents this afternoon: Mara Vale's hold was released and she cannot appear Saturday. Lio Hart is available, but only from 7:40 PM to 7:55 PM. I haven't updated the booking grid yet because the confirmations came in while the grid was locked for payroll review.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share my transmission test results from this morning. A remote duet feed would create an unacceptable five-second return-path delay, which would be a serious problem for a live segment. However, Lio Hart can perform a live in-studio solo through the tested local audio path with no issues. I haven't entered this into the technical packet yet because it's still awaiting the final camera map, but the test results are clear and relevant to our decision here.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share a critical clearance issue. My rights search confirmed that the routine Lio Hart proposed, which uses the song 'Midnight Parade,' cannot be cleared for the broadcast. The approved replacement is the spoken-word routine 'Open Tabs,' with the on-air credit 'Written and performed by Lio Hart.' I haven't circulated the clearance note yet because the rights database export is still being attached to the file, but this is confirmed and final.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to share a sponsor integration constraint. My signed sponsor addendum prohibits competitor beverage products and logos from appearing in Lio Hart's segment, and it requires the benefit sponsor's lower-third to appear once during that segment. I haven't uploaded the addendum yet because the sponsor portal rejected the first file format, but the terms are signed and binding.
transcript.speaker: A5
